# Localized External Sources

This directory contains local, searchable representations for all 44 external records in `source_registry.yaml`.

- `cards/`: one structured knowledge card per source.
- `structured/`: exact machine-readable ranking/list snapshots.
- `catalog.yaml`: local path, rights, refresh, and runtime policy.
- `external_topic_router.yaml`: topic-to-source routing.
- `source_capture_manifest.yaml` and `.csv`: per-source audit evidence and hashes.

The cards are source-derived representations, not indiscriminate raw mirrors. Open resources are represented by detailed learning maps; commercial and restricted sources are represented only by public metadata, public tables of contents, abstracts, official guidance, and operational rules.

The unified local index contains 1869 chunks, including 269 external-source chunks and 1600 empirical-book chunks.
